t: You are at Chelsea Square, a garden square in Chelsea. Two residents are on record. Albert Gray, a British colonial administrator who lived from 1850 to 1928, died here. Helen Chetwynd-Stapylton, who lived from 1916 to 1994, lived here. Their lives span much of the square's story from the late nineteenth century into the late twentieth, though I have little more to say about either of them.
